privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body1: This game uses the microphone only to measure how loud your breath is and what kind of sound it is. Audio is never recorded, stored, or transmitted.
privacy.body2: There are no ads, no in-app purchases, no analytics, and no network calls while you play. Progress is saved only on this device.
privacy.body3: Calm Breathing is a gentle game, not a medical or therapy tool.
